title: An Owner downloads a backup point as one zip; the doors are off unless BACKUP_EXPORT=on
steps: S1: run packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/backup-export.test.mjs — the host packs a verified point into one zip (config DB settings replaced by placeholders, dump byte for byte, SHA256SUMS, locks let go before the upload) and refuses a tampered dump, a package too large, a refused upload; no container.
S2: run apps/tracy-host/test/webroot.test.mjs + config.test.mjs (pattern export) — kind webroot-export takes an https upload address through the environment only, never on argv.

S3: run apps/tracy-web/test/backup-export.test.mjs — Owner only on both doors, 404 EXPORT_OFF when the deployment leaves BACKUP_EXPORT unset and may.export=false, one export per site at a time, caps per account, ready only once the store holds the size, five-minute link, expiry + sweep, delete with the site, the generic artifact doors refuse backup-exports/ and dot segments.
S4: run packages/core/tracy-core/test/backup-download.test.mjs — Download… is offered to an Owner on a full backup only.
expect: S1: exit 0, 0 failures, 9 pass; 'export: a full WordPress point becomes one zip' passes.
S2: exit 0, 0 failures; 'runWebrootJob: webroot-export hands the upload address in the environment' passes.
S3: exit 0, 0 failures, 0 skipped, 12 pass; 'artifact doors: no key in the export namespace' passes.
fence: ADR 0024 forbids returning a raw dump; this line ships behind BACKUP_EXPORT (default off) and as amendment 3 awaiting owner approval. The bytes never pass through tracy-web: the host uploads to the artifact store through a presigned PUT and tracy-web signs a five-minute GET. Web and desktop get the same door on the same site tab (ADR 0030).
